title: PushPull++: A Progressive Image Transmission Technique Using Image Warping and Pixel Replacement
abstract: This work presents PushPull++, a new technique for progressive image transmission based on the PushPull method. The technique aims at efficient transmission of images over networks, improving image quality at further stages of transmission while minimizing the number of transmitted bits. It employs image warping and pixel replacement to enhance visual coherence and reduce delivery time of a visually acceptable image during initialization phases.
summary:
The paper "PushPull++: A Progressive Image Transmission Technique Using Image Warping and Pixel Replacement" introduces an advanced method known as PushPull++, which enhances the classic PushPull technique. This method focuses on progressive image transmission by utilizing image warping and pixel replacement, aiming to improve the quality of images transmitted over networks while minimizing transmitted data.

The PushPull++ method shows potential in applications requiring efficient image transmission, such as remote sensing and computer graphics, where bandwidth optimization is critical. By refining image quality at progressive stages and utilizing animated transitions, this research contributes to more efficient remote rendering techniques.
